_doc: Phase-81c promotion severity/impact gate taxonomy (RESEARCH-ONLY, un-wired). Closes the P81a D2 gap: a claim can be SOURCE-TRUE yet not H/M-worthy (transient/dust impact). This gate demotes such promotions below POC_REQUIRED. It is advisory and fail-closed on unproven impact (prefer NEEDS_CONTEXT over a thin promotion). It NEVER edits deep_pass/hygiene/transitions and NEVER sets production severity.
_p81f_calibration: P81d showed the gate, fed a reviewer's conservative low/revert language, false-demoted two TRUE Mediums (Stargate fixed-fee, UniSwapper stale-params). Calibration: a `low`-labelled candidate is NOT auto-demoted when the impact_assessment asserts a source-backed CONCRETE material consequence (below). Conservative wording (revert/estimation/routing/bridge/execution failure) by itself no longer demotes a true Medium. DUST/transient with NO concrete consequence still demotes (preserves the P81a D2 fix).
_p86_calibration: P85 (Munchables) over-rated `updateTaxRate` (a bounded/lazy-settlement accounting issue tagged misrouted_funds) as Medium and the gate KEPT it (severity FP) -- the inverse of P81e's DoS UNDER-rating. P86 tiers consequences: only `concrete_material_consequences` justify keeping a promotion; `bounded_nonmaterial_consequences` (misrouted_funds, accounting_drift, rate_mismatch, stale_parameter, delayed_settlement, ...) and `bounded_lazy_markers` signal a bounded/lazy/accounting candidate that DEMOTES unless a source-backed concrete consequence is also present -- regardless of declared impact_class, so a declared High can no longer save weak evidence. `misrouted_funds` is intentionally NOT concrete; `reward_loss_not_recoverable` IS (H-05 class).
_p88_calibration: P87 exposed the OPPOSITE (under-rating) direction P86 didn't address: H-01 mintWithBudget (a permanent function-brick / liveness) was kept but under-rated, and M-18 forgeWithListed (an INVOLUNTARY fee-reduction race -> stuck funds) was false-demoted as self-inflicted. P88 adds a liveness/involuntary ELEVATION that runs AFTER the non-material-class + dust-magnitude floors (so D2/dust robustness is preserved) but BEFORE the bounded-demote: a source-backed LIVENESS consequence, or an INVOLUNTARY harm with a concrete consequence, is KEPT and never demoted -- and reported as `high` when high_liveness_markers prove a core/all-users/unrecoverable brick. This does NOT re-open the P85/P86 hole: a bounded/lazy issue with only misrouted_funds/stale_parameter and no concrete/liveness/involuntary signal still DEMOTES (rule 5), even if declared High.
_policy: Among PROMOTION-status decisions, in ORDER: (1) non-promotion passes through unchanged. (2) if impact_class in {dust,qa,informational,gas,none,negligible} -> DEMOTE (non-material CLASS floor; preserves D2 robustness even if a material tag is mis-attached). (3) if proven_magnitude is a demote magnitude (dust/transient/none/...) AND no source-backed CONCRETE consequence -> DEMOTE (D2 magnitude). (4) P88 ELEVATION: if a source-backed LIVENESS consequence is present, OR the harm is INVOLUNTARY (involuntary_markers) with a concrete consequence -> KEEP; report impact_class `high` when high_liveness_markers are present, else `medium`. (5) if BOUNDED (any bounded_lazy_marker, OR consequence tags all bounded_nonmaterial with no concrete) AND NOT concrete -> DEMOTE (P86: declared High cannot save bounded/lazy evidence). (6) impact_class == 'low': KEEP iff source-backed CONCRETE consequence, else DEMOTE. (7) impact_class in material_impact_classes -> KEEP. (8) unproven -> FAIL-CLOSED. `concrete`=source_true AND >=1 concrete tag; `liveness`=source_true AND >=1 liveness tag; consequences/markers come from the key-blind investigation, never an answer key.
